title: Church music and his religion
summary: Churches had a lot of singing; he was Catholic but attends Baptist and spiritual churches.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Did you hear much music in the churches? Did you belong to a church in those days? Did you ever go to the churches? Did you hear any of the singing there? What kind of music they had there?
Well, they had a lot of singing in the churches at that time. Brother Bowling's number and stuff like that, you know.
Which church did you go to? Were you Catholic or Protestant or Baptist?
I used to go to all of them, but I was Catholic, but I go to all of them now. Sometimes I fall in the Baptist church and sometimes I used to play in the spiritual church,
Yes, I know sometimes they have music in there.
